decision.explanation: The original sources confirm that Enrique Matta Figueroa served as a member of the Chamber of Deputies of Chile (D1S3) and as a deputy of Chile (D1S1), both referring to the same role in the Chilean legislature. Additionally, Document D2S2 explicitly states that he was appointed as the Minister of Finance in Brazil. These three distinct positions—two former roles in Chile and one current role in Brazil—are supported by direct textual evidence and do not conflict with each other.
